- Wooden chests: all 1562 of the world's wooden chests, wooden sarcophagi and locked wooden chests, under World & Resources > Wooden Chest (off at first, switch it on). Looted ones are hidden or grayed out and keep their check mark like gold and silver, they glow with G G, and Find finds them. Requested by AnkuSol.
- G G also lights what the quests you're on want near you: the quest's item or place, with its quest icon, while the Main Quest / Side Quest rows are on. Requested by Gadn.
- Search this list finds places by their name too: type 3 letters or more of a lore note, boss, place or pin and its row shows with that name ("Lore Note: Song Of ..."), even when the row is off.
- Pins: EXPLORED no longer hides what the game itself shows: places it knows of in land still fogged (drawn faded), places you've discovered, and lore rumor hints such as "Undiscovered: Shroud Root"; towns like the Alchemist Tower and cave passages get their rumor "?" too. A started quest's search area (Cat Search, the Customization quests) shows under its quest's row. Reported by secretroff.
- Pins: REVEAL ALL shows every place in full colour, the ones you haven't discovered yet too (EXPLORED and HYBRID still gray those out). Locked spires and fast travel points keep their gray.
- Faster: the minimap and the world map do about half the work they did each frame, and joining a world with many locked filters no longer freezes the game for seconds. Reported by kingkongcs.
- Fixed: with a controller, the world map could stop answering it after the mouse was used, until the mouse moved again. Reported by FamanFortune.
